items.title: US removes all bombers from RAF Fairford base
items.summary: A statement says all bombers deployed to RAF Fairford have been "re-deployed to their home stations" in the US.

items.title: Polanski banned from Israel after party's motion declaring 'Zionism is racism'
items.summary: The vote has caused divisions among figures at the top of the party at its conference in Brighton.

items.title: Brazil election goes to run-off as right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro wins first round
items.summary: With neither candidate getting more than 50% of the vote, the election will go to a run-off on 25 October.

items.title: Protesters scuffle with police as migrants brought ashore on south coast
items.summary: The Home Office said 149 migrants were brought ashore and taken by coach to a processing centre in Kent.

items.title: Shadow chancellor to unveil Tory plans to cut taxes and regulations
items.summary: Shadow ministers will unveil a series of policies on day two of the Conservative Party conference in Birmingham.

items.title: France closes up to 500 schools over student protests
items.summary: Lessons will be "totally or partly suspended" in some high schools after clashes between riot police and student protesters, France's education minister says.

items.title: Potty training scheme to roll out to 20 more areas
items.summary: The government wants 75% of children to end their first year of school with a good level of development by 2028.

items.title: Trump unveils 'Super Intelligence Force' to oversee AI policy
items.summary: The president named his national intelligence chief as the taskforce's head as worries over AI grow.
